verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI outputs data in open, portable formats (markdown, JSON) and is open-source with no forced API keys, which inherently avoids proprietary lock-in on scraped data (crawl4ai-docs-4, crawl4ai-docs-5). However, there is no evidence of an explicit feature to export job/crawl configurations in a standardized portable format for migrating to another provider — crawl configs are just Python code/CLI args, not a documented export/import mechanism. Missing for 10: documented config export/import tooling, explicit migration guidance, evidence of standardized schema/config portability beyond raw code.
